title: Starfall Harbor: Beacon of the Deep
description: A sprawling maritime mystery across a storm-lashed port city and the abyssal sanctum beneath it.
intro:
The sea has turned strange around Starfall Harbor. Fishing boats return empty, lighthouse flames burn blue, and whispers of a drowned crown drift through every tavern and alley.

You arrive just as the harbor’s great beacon begins to fail. To save the city, you will need to navigate smugglers’ routes, question wary locals, restore ancient lamps, and descend beneath the tides into the ruins of a forgotten throne.

This showcase adventure demonstrates open exploration, combat, consumables, readable clues, NPC dialogue, layered quests, and interconnected routes using both standard and custom exits.

rooms.name: Beacon Square
rooms.description: Starfall Harbor’s main plaza is paved with wet stone and ringed by shuttered storefronts. At its center rises an old signal brazier, currently dim and sputtering beneath the rain.

rooms.name: Saltwind Market
rooms.description: Canvas awnings snap in the coastal wind while merchants pack away spices, rope, oil, and charms against bad weather. Rumors move here faster than coin.

rooms.name: Tideglass Library
rooms.description: Rows of barnacle-carved shelves hold sea journals, port records, and maps of reefs no sailor admits to using. The windows glow with pale green light from the surf outside.

rooms.name: Fisher Quays
rooms.description: Tar-black ropes, overturned crab pots, and salt-stiff nets cover the docks. The tide slaps angrily against the pilings, and more than one boat shows signs of a hasty and frightened return.

rooms.name: Cliffside Switchback
rooms.description: A steep stone path winds upward toward the old stormwatch towers. Gulls wheel overhead, and the roar of the surf below makes every shout feel swallowed by the world.

rooms.name: Customs Hall
rooms.description: Ledger desks, inspection crates, and sealed manifests fill this imposing hall. Officials once maintained strict order here, but now the ink is smeared and half the doors are hanging open.

rooms.name: Moonpool Garden
rooms.description: A hidden courtyard full of tide-fed pools and moon-white flowers. Lantern reflections shimmer across the water, and for a moment the whole harbor feels peaceful again.

rooms.name: Smuggler Caves
rooms.description: Sea caves open beneath the docks, full of contraband crates, lantern smoke, and the smell of brine. A narrow tunnel leads deeper inland toward secrets the harbor would rather deny.

rooms.name: Stormwatch Ramparts
rooms.description: From these high walls the whole harbor stretches below like a storm-tossed map. The beacon tower stands close now, its fractured lens flashing erratic blue pulses across the sea.

rooms.name: Chapel of the Last Lantern
rooms.description: A quiet stone chapel where sailors leave prayers, names of the dead, and tiny offerings for safe return. Rows of candles burn low, their reflections trembling in bowls of rainwater.

rooms.name: Astronomer's Court
rooms.description: An open-air terrace of brass astrolabes and chipped observatory tables. Charts pinned beneath glass describe stars that only appear over dangerous waters.

rooms.name: Pearl Market Vault
rooms.description: A reinforced chamber beneath the merchant quarter, stacked with sealed boxes, pearl caskets, and carefully hidden ledgers. Several locks have been forced recently from the inside.

rooms.name: Drowned King's Vestibule
rooms.description: Flooded stone ruins emerge from the darkness beyond the smugglers’ route. Ancient carvings of wave-crowned rulers line the walls, worn smooth by centuries of hidden tide.

rooms.name: Abyssal Beacon Crown
rooms.description: You stand atop the harbor’s sacred beacon where sea-light, wind, and old magic collide. Beneath the cracked lens, the deep itself seems to stare back through a ring of runes and stormfire.

items.name: Harbor Cutlass
items.description: A practical sailor’s blade, nicked from real use but still sharp enough for close work.

items.name: Smoked Eel Rations
items.description: Wrapped strips of savory eel, preserved for bad weather and longer voyages.

items.name: Beacon Oil
items.description: A rare alchemical fuel used to keep the harbor’s storm-lamps burning even in heavy rain.

items.name: Tideglass Index
items.description: A catalog of drowned ships, hidden shoals, and suspicious salvage rights.

items.name: Gullfeather Cloak
items.description: A salt-resistant traveler’s cloak stitched with soft gray feather lining.

items.name: Netminder's Journal
items.description: One page is underlined three times: 'Do not go below the quays after moonrise. The caves answer back.'

items.name: Navigator's Tea
items.description: A hot herbal brew concentrate used to steady nerves before rough crossings.

items.name: Customs Seal
items.description: A wax-and-brass official seal authorizing access to restricted storage and tower routes.

items.name: Moonlit Kelp
items.description: A glowing edible frond gathered from tidal pools where moonlight clings to the water.

items.name: Smuggler Brand
items.description: A carved ivory token marking safe passage among the harbor’s black-market crews.

items.name: Stormglass Prism
items.description: A faceted lens shard meant to refocus the failing beacon flame.

items.name: Lantern Charm
items.description: A simple devotional charm blessed for safe return through fog and storm.

items.name: Star Chart
items.description: A waterproof astronomical chart showing an alignment that only occurs during severe coastal squalls.

items.name: Pearl Locket
items.description: A delicate silver locket containing a portrait of the harbor before the strange tides began.

items.name: Abyssal Conch
items.description: A black shell that hums faintly when held to the ear, as if the sea itself is whispering through it.

items.name: Beacon Heart Shard
items.description: A radiant crystal fragment that burns with contained stormlight and old oath-magic.

items.name: Tide Harpoon
items.description: A long hooked weapon favored by reef wardens and abyssal sentries.

monsters.name: Harbormaster Mira
monsters.description: A steady-eyed civic leader who refuses to abandon the people of Starfall, no matter what rises from the surf.

monsters.name: Market Runner Pell
monsters.description: A quick-footed courier with one eye on the tide charts and the other on profitable gossip.

monsters.name: Archivist Orrin
monsters.description: A tired but brilliant scholar who sees the harbor’s troubles as a puzzle waiting to be solved.

monsters.name: Dockside Knifehand
monsters.description: A thug from the harbor gangs, lurking among rope coils and stolen crates.

monsters.name: Storm Gull Flock
monsters.description: A vicious pack of unnatural sea birds whose eyes flash with cold blue light.

monsters.name: Pearl Broker Selka
monsters.description: An impeccably dressed merchant who knows every legal and illegal route through the harbor.

monsters.name: Reef Lurker
monsters.description: A slick deepwater hunter dragging broken nets and barnacled hooks behind it.

monsters.name: Drowned Sentinel
monsters.description: An armored guardian animated by sea-magic and bound to defend the submerged throne road.

monsters.name: Abyssal Priest
monsters.description: A fanatical servant of the deep crowned in coral and stormfire, chanting beneath the broken lens.

quests.title: Rekindle the Beacon
quests.description: Recover the lamp fuel and climb to the stormwatch heights so the harbor’s guiding flame can be restored.

quests.title: Break the Smuggler Ring
quests.description: Expose the harbor gangs by seizing their mark and defeating the knifehand leading the dockside crews.

quests.title: Seal the Abyss Below
quests.description: Descend into the old drowned sanctum and defeat the priest using the beacon to call something monstrous from the depths.
